latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Solana Deploy Engineer.

- Provides structured workflows for setting up and deploying Solana and Anchor dApps.
- Automates installation and configuration of Rust, Solana (Agave/Anza), Anchor (via AVM), Node.js, pnpm, and related tooling.
- Supports deployment to localnet, devnet, and mainnet-beta with strict safety and verification procedures.
- Handles verifiable builds, buffer-based upgrades, priority-fee strategies, and recovery from deployment failures.
- Guides best practices for environment separation, authority management (including Squads multisig), and reproducible deployments.
